title: fix: wrap Storybook stories with global SchemaRendererProvider decorator
body:
~15 story files render plugin components (kanban, timeline, charts, calendar, grid, etc.) without `SchemaRendererProvider`, causing `useSchemaContext must be used within a SchemaRendererProvider` errors across Storybook.

### Global decorator (`.storybook/preview.ts`)

Single fix for all affected stories — wraps every story with `SchemaRendererProvider` providing an empty `dataSource`. Stories needing a real dataSource still work because the innermost provider wins via React context.

```ts
const withSchemaProvider: Decorator = (Story) =>
  React.createElement(SchemaRendererProvider, { dataSource: {} }, React.createElement(Story));

const preview: Preview = {
  decorators: [withSchemaProvider],
  // ...
};
```

### Console error detection (`.storybook/test-runner.cjs`)

- `preVisit` now collects `console.error` calls
- `postVisit` asserts no critical errors (`must be used within`, `Uncaught Error`, React error boundary messages)
- Catches this class of missing-provider bugs in CI before they reach users

### Smoke tests (`packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRendererProvider.smoke.test.tsx`)

14 tests covering:
- `useSchemaContext` throws outside provider, works inside
- `SchemaRenderer` + provider integration
- All 9 plugin types (`kanban`, `timeline`, `chart`, `object-grid`, etc.) render without provider errors
